[i]Behind every great man stands a great woman. But standing even further behind them—in the shadows and just barely out of sight—is an even greater manager.[/i]

Sergei Ivankov is the World☆Class Manager, a man who “gets things done.” His current profession revolves around taking care of a certain World☆Class Idol and ensuring that every appearance, ad, meet-and-greet, and concert is a resounding success. Despite his charge’s universal recognition, Sergei’s personal claim to fame is that his current name is known only to a select few, and his true self known by even fewer.

Likes: Music, negotiating, documentaries, drip
Dislikes: Cold weather, manipulative people, thrill rides
